report.summary: The detection model (dentex_teeth_detection_v1) located 33 tooth region(s). Of these, 32 have a tooth number from the numbering model, 32 have a matched segmentation mask, and 22 are flagged for manual review. Segmentation masks come from the segmentation model (dentex_teeth_segmentation_v1) and are matched to regions by overlap. Tooth numbers (FDI) come from the numbering model (dentex_fdi_numbering_v1); regions it did not match stay unnumbered. The classification model (dentex_findings_classification_v1) gave each region its closest class among four trained findings. It has no healthy class, so a class name here is not a statement that the finding is present.
limitations: Findings are model predictions and may be wrong; uncertainty values are not guarantees of correctness.
The classification model has no healthy class and was trained only on teeth labelled with one of four findings; its closest-class output does not indicate that a tooth is affected.
No clinical history or other examinations were considered.
Tooth numbers marked 'unassigned' or 'needs_review' were not confirmed.
